items.source: The default implementation removes BindingResult instances and entries not included in the modelKeys property.
items.translation: 默认实现会移除 `BindingResult` 实例以及未包含在 `modelKeys` 属性中的条目。

items.source: By default, the entire contents of the model map (with the exception of framework-specific classes) will be encoded as JSON. If the model contains only one key, you can have it extracted encoded as JSON alone via setExtractValueFromSingleKeyModel(boolean).
items.translation: 默认情况下，模型映射的全部内容（框架特定类除外）将编码为 JSON。如果模型仅包含一个键，您可以通过setExtractValueFromSingleKeyModel(boolean)将其单独提取并编码为 JSON。

items.source: Default is false.
items.translation: 默认值为false。

items.source:
Prefixing the JSON string in this manner is used to help prevent JSON Hijacking.
The prefix renders the string syntactically invalid as a script so that it cannot be hijacked.
This prefix should be stripped before parsing the string as JSON.
items.translation: 以这种方式在 JSON 字符串前添加前缀，有助于防止 JSON 劫持。该前缀使字符串在语法上无效，从而无法被劫持。在将字符串解析为 JSON 之前，应移除此前缀。

items.source: Indicates whether the JSON output by this view should be prefixed with ")]}', ".

items.source: Default content type: "application/json".
items.translation: 默认内容类型："application/json"。

items.translation: 设置是将包含单个属性的模型序列化为 Map，还是从模型中提取单个值并直接序列化它。
